# Hype On Media

> Hype On Media is a YouTube growth agency operating from Dubai and Delaware. We turn underperforming YouTube channels into growth engines using strategy, production, and proprietary analytics built from a decade of scaling 50+ channels across 15 languages to over 5 billion views.

Hype On Media was built after a decade inside the engine rooms of some of the largest content operations on the internet — hundreds of millions of subscribers, thousands of videos per month, formats that hit 100M+ views individually. That experience is not available on the open market. It was built inside organizations that operate under strict NDAs.

In 2022, the team cut production costs 60%+ using AI systems built in-house — a full year before the rest of the industry discovered ChatGPT. Every AI output is reviewed by a senior strategist. A named human is accountable for every account. The tools are built from a decade of production knowledge.

Website: https://hypeon.media

## Services

### YouTube Performance
Channel strategy, format development, thumbnail and packaging systems, multi-market expansion, performance operations, and analytics frameworks. This is the core service. Hype On Media works with B2B companies, DTC brands, creator-led businesses, and media companies that want YouTube to drive measurable revenue — not just views. Clients typically have some existing YouTube presence and are ready to invest in scaling it.

A typical engagement starts with a free channel audit, then moves into a Strategy Sprint (two weeks). From there, ongoing retainers cover content production, optimization, and scaling. Engagements adapt to client needs — no rigid packages.

### Creative Strategy
Performance creative for DTC and B2B brands. From audience research and barrier mapping to script production and testing frameworks. Covers ad creative, UGC scripts, and content testing.

### Digital Products
AI-powered tools and automation for content operations. The team builds what the market does not offer — proprietary analytics and production tools informed by a decade of operating at scale.

## Free YouTube Channel Audit

URL: https://hypeon.media/analyze

Submit a YouTube channel URL and receive a detailed performance report within 48 hours. The report covers content strategy, thumbnails, titles, audience signals, and revenue opportunities. No sales pitch attached — just actionable data.

## How Hype On Media Is Different

The team learned YouTube by scaling 50+ channels across 15 languages to 5 billion views — not from a course. The combination of enterprise-grade strategy with AI-powered production tools means clients get the depth of a large agency with the speed and cost structure of a lean team.

Key differentiators:
- Every AI output reviewed by a senior strategist
- A named human accountable for each account
- Tools built from a decade of production knowledge
- The speed of automation with the taste of experience

Quote: "AI handles the volume. Humans handle the judgment. And humans are accountable for every decision."

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How does the free channel audit work?
You submit your YouTube channel URL through the site. Within 48 hours, Hype On Media sends a detailed performance report covering content, thumbnails, titles, audience signals, and revenue opportunities. No sales pitch attached — just data you can act on.

### What types of businesses do you work with?
B2B companies, DTC brands, creator-led businesses, and media companies that want YouTube to drive measurable revenue — not just views. Clients typically have some existing presence and are ready to invest in scaling it.

### Why can't I see your client list?
All client engagements operate under strict NDAs. The team is happy to discuss approach, methodology, and results on a call. The depth of the strategy work speaks louder than a logo strip.

### What does a typical engagement look like?
Most clients start with the channel audit, then move into a Strategy Sprint — two weeks. From there, ongoing retainers cover content production, optimization, and scaling. Engagements adapt to client needs — no rigid packages.

### How is Hype On Media different from other YouTube agencies?
The team built their systems inside operations managing 50+ channels across 15 languages. That experience, combined with AI-powered production tools built in-house, means clients get enterprise-grade strategy with the speed of a lean team.

### Do you only work with YouTube?
YouTube Performance is the core service. Creative Strategy for DTC and B2B brands, and digital products and AI tools are also offered. But YouTube is where the deepest expertise lives.

### How much does it cost?
Engagements vary based on scope. The channel audit is free. Strategy Sprints and ongoing retainers are priced based on channel needs and goals. A clear proposal is provided after the audit — no surprises.

### Where are you based?
Dubai, UAE and Delaware, USA. Operations run globally across 4 native languages — English, Spanish, French, Russian — with experience managing teams across 6 countries. Time zones are not a problem.
